rows.review_depth: Retained field/policy replay and displayed-source population checks; no new source review in this assessment. No equivalent consolidated analyst-complete package approval established.

S3.name: Expense D&A perimeter and timing disposition
S3.stop: Unavailable amortization/inventory/lease overlap with no defensible basis remains blocking; do not infer zero or reopen exhausted research.

S4.acceptance: Required purchase perimeter selected with complete/non-overlap evidence or an explicitly justified accepted alternative; allocations remain separate if not required by the approved perimeter.
S4.action: Review approved cash Capex alongside unapproved broader captions, acquisition/intangible spending, creditors and noncash additions. A policy amount is not complete reinvestment.
S4.name: Cash investment scope and unavailable allocations
S4.stop: No disclosed allocation and no defensible alternative means incomplete for the broader requested perimeter; no estimate from residuals.

S5.acceptance: Selected required rows and omissions have approved rationale; any reconciliation has independently bound operands, no balancing plug, no book-delta substitution, no duplicate SBC. Provision/pretax/ETR/cash/deferred roles remain separate.
S5.action: Classify exact movement/tax/SBC rows, preserve signs and acquisition/FX/reclassification scope; resolve supported/partial/failed displayed CFO checks. Determine whether a remainder is required and retain its unclassified role.
S5.name: CFO reconciliation roles and historical tax/SBC/movement decisions
S5.stop: MCD failed check cannot pass by widening tolerance; unresolved hierarchy or undisclosed allocations remain blocking if required. No future tax rate.

S6.acceptance: No knowingly double-counted debt/lease/claims; every required population/class/date accounted for, or a defensible explicit alternative accepted. Narrow totals retain labels; no excess-cash or dilution claim.
S6.action: Use current bridge observations/partitions to select required named populations and exclusions; resolve carrying/principal/fair-value, class/date, restricted/strategic and parent-child scope. Do not force a combined total.
S6.name: Financial balances, borrowing/lease, claims and dated-share selection
S6.stop: Unknown short debt, restrictions, claims or class coverage is not zero. Named subtotal approval alone does not exclude unknown populations.

S7.acceptance: Every available selected annual independently satisfies the completion checklist; opening/movement scope proved only when required and evidenced. Missing target slots separately dispositioned.
S7.action: After one-period completion, repeat exact evidence/decisions over remaining selected annuals, checking acquisitions, FX, reclassification, leases and stock-versus-cash boundaries; do not extend a pilot approval implicitly.
S7.name: Full available-history extension and comparability
S7.stop: Standalone/predecessor or empty registrant history cannot be filled by invented periods. Additional evidence/continuity approval is an external dependency, not scheduled completion.

target_definition: Every required input selected with evidence, defensible approved estimate/classification, or genuinely necessary approved methodological exclusion; acknowledged gaps are not complete.
